blocks.heading: RSS Feed
blocks.lead: Follow the latest press releases and activity news of the Office of the Royal Society with an RSS reader

blocks.heading: Office RSS feeds
blocks.lead: RSS (Really Simple Syndication) is a file format for publishing frequently updated news. Add the RSS link to an RSS reader or news app to receive the Office's latest news without visiting the website.

blocks.heading: How to follow news via RSS
blocks.lead: It takes less than a minute and only needs doing once. New Office news will then arrive straight in your RSS reader.

items.title: Copy the RSS link
items.body: Press “Copy” next to the RSS link above to copy the full link instantly.

items.title: Open your RSS reader
items.body: Open the RSS reader or app you use and choose to add a new feed

items.title: Paste the link and save
items.body: Paste the copied link and save. New Office news will then appear in the reader automatically.
